name: github-tracking
description: Keeps a repo's GitHub issues, milestones and Projects board true while Claude works. Its track skill says how the board works, and a script moves issues and PRs on it, makes sub-issues and posts status updates, so no CLAUDE.md keeps a project's ids. /github-tracking:init sets up the board and its views. Which work gets an issue, and how it's labelled, stay yours to set in your CLAUDE.md.
